description: Copy an effect parameter's keyframes (values and interpolation) to the same or another parameter on other clips or the same clip (Effect Controls, copy and paste keyframes). Times keep their offset from each clip's In point, plus offset. Keyframes are one undo step, interpolation a second

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

offset.description: Shift the pasted keyframes by this many seconds. Default 0

param.description: Parameter name as list_clip_effects reports it, e.g. "Scale"

paramIndex.description: Parameter index instead of a name

replace.description: Remove the target parameter's own keyframes first. Default false

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

to.description: The clips to paste onto. Default: the source clip

items.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

selected.description: Include the clips selected in the Timeline

toComponent.description: Target component index. Default: the source's

toParam.description: Target parameter name. Default: the source's

toParamIndex.description: Target parameter index instead of a name

name: copy_keyframes
title: Copy Keyframes
